mapper.select: SELECT id, patient_id, type, enabled, advance_minutes, notification_method, template_id, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted, tenant_id FROM reminder_configs WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY type ASC

SELECT id, patient_id, type, enabled, advance_minutes, notification_method, template_id, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted, tenant_id FROM reminder_configs WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND type = #{type} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, patient_id, type, enabled, advance_minutes, notification_method, template_id, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted, tenant_id FROM reminder_configs WHERE type = #{type} AND enabled = 1 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY patient_id ASC
